change_6_cinema_mode.instruction:
Add a Cinema Mode fullscreen overlay that activates when the operator clicks 'Cinema Mode' on Mission Control. Source: cinema_mockup.html — use Concept 1 (Cinema Mode, element #c1) as the implementation.

1. Add a 'Cinema Mode' button to the Mission Control screen header (inside .screen-head for screen-mission-control in index.html).
2. Create ui/assets/modules/cinema.js that exports openCinemaMode() and closeCinemaMode(). openCinemaMode() creates a fullscreen overlay div with id='cinema-overlay' appended to body, containing the SVG node graph, animated spider threads, topbar with live stats (hosts found, findings, active tools), and phase lane tabs from cinema_mockup.html #c1.
3. Copy the exact CSS from cinema_mockup.html <style> block for: #c1, .c1-topbar, .c1-logo, .c1-status, .c1-pulse, @keyframes pulse, .c1-right, .c1-stat, .c1-canvas, .cinema-svg, .node-ring, @keyframes sonar into styles.css.
4. Add an ESC key handler that calls closeCinemaMode().
5. Import cinema.js in app.js and wire the button click to openCinemaMode().
6. The Cinema overlay has a close button ('✕ Exit Cinema') in the top-right that calls closeCinemaMode().

constraints.active_task_gate: This task is promoted to NEXT_TASK.md immediately — operator-escalated priority.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only the six changes above. Do not touch backend, pack registry, API routes, or any screen not listed.
constraints.test_suite: Run python -m pytest api/tests/test_health.py after changes. UI tests: open http://localhost:8000/app, verify tiles show emoji icons and phase tags, verify sidebar has exactly 5 items, verify Cinema Mode opens on button click.

success_criteria: Wizard tiles show emoji icons (🌐 🖧 🏠 🛡️ 🎯 ☁️ { } 🤖 ⚙️) — not text labels (WEB, LAN, AD).
Tiles show Popular/New/Complete/AD color badges in top-right of tile-top.
Tiles show phase tags row at the bottom (passive · active · credential · exploit).
Selected tile shows a numbered badge (1) in top-right corner.
A 'Selected: [icon] [name] ×' chips bar appears above the tile grid when a tile is selected.
A combo hint appears when Internal LAN or Active Directory is selected.
A sticky step bar at the bottom of the wizard shows 1·Choose / 2·Target / 3·Preview / 4·Launch pills.
Sidebar shows exactly 5 items with icon prefix: ⬡ Intake / ◈ Mission Control / ⚠ Findings / ☰ Reports / ⚙ Settings — no group category labels.
Step indicator uses .step-dot circles (.done=green, .active=cyan, .pending=grey) and .step-line connectors.
Mission Control has a 'Cinema Mode' button that opens a fullscreen dark overlay with animated SVG node graph.
Cinema Mode overlay can be closed with ESC or the close button.
